dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains fish species details from CVC Aquatic Biology (monitoring) Database and CVC Fish Collection Record Database for the period 1999 2025. CVC-collected data only. Partnership projects such as Lake Ontario Atlantic Salmon monitoring with/on behalf of MNR are not included. 

Click for Metadata here: Fish Collection records metadata (1999-2025)

How to download this data:

1.Scroll down to the Layers section and click the layer name: FishCollectionRecords1999_2025

2.To download the whole dataset: click the Download button and choose your preferred format (CSV, Shapefile, GeoJSON, etc.).

3.To download only specific/filtered records,  visit the interactive mapping.

 

💡 Tip: Clicking on a point on the map opens an attribute info window with details for that record. You can dock or undock this window.

NOTE: This dataset cannot be downloaded directly from ArcGIS Online; please use the CVC's Open Data portal to download the data.
